hits.snippet: # Medical Robotics Startup Vexev Secures $8.6M #### Synopsis The UNSW spinout is accelerating US regulatory approval and commercial rollout of its VxWave tomographic ultrasound technology after lifting total funding to $27 million. Sydney-based medical robotics start-up Vexev has raised a $8.6m funding round, to fast-track its U.S. regulatory approval and commercialization of its VxWave ultrasound platform. Blackbird Ventures is among the investors that have backed Vexev in the past. It is a privately held firm, and therefore does not publicise revenue or profit figures. With the new funding, Vexev's total raised capital increases to $27 million and will be used for expanding its manufacturing capabilities and development of its products along with getting approval from the regulators. Vexev was established in 2018 as a spinout of the University of New South Wales (UNSW), where they're developing automated vascular imaging robotic ultrasound systems for dialysis patients.
